Subject: Demo — potential timing conflict for VP travel window

Hi Aditya,

Quick heads up — our VP of Product (Asha) just got a short transit window on Tue 22 Apr when she'll be between meetings and available for a 25–30 minute slot (11:45–12:15 PT). Our CTO (Ravi) is traveling and said he can only join toward the end of your demo (around 12:05 PT) if we compress the session.

Can your team do a two-part run (short exec-focused 30m deck + a deeper 45m technical block right after) or compress to a single 45m run that hits executive highlights first? We want to make sure Asha sees the key ROI stuff but also let Ravi jump in for the product/infra Q&A at the end.

If you can share a suggested agenda and whether you have availability that day, that'd be great.

Thanks,
Erin

Hi Erin —

Thanks for the context — we can absolutely adapt. Two pragmatic options from our side:

1) Two-slot approach (recommended):
   - Block A (Exec brief): 11:45–12:15 PT — 30 min focused on value props, ROI, and a 5-min live demo of top-line flows for Asha.
   - Block B (Tech deep-dive): 12:20–1:05 PT — 45 min detailed session for Ravi and engineering, includes architecture, latency/cost profile, and integration Q&A.

2) Compressed single session: 11:45–12:30 PT — 45 min where we lead with an executive 15-min highlight, then transition to product/tech. Ravi can join at 12:05 and we’ll make sure the first 15 mins are executive-only content.

I've attached a short agenda (demo-agenda-v2.pdf) and a proposed mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) so you can see what we’ll cover in each block. If you prefer, we can also do the two-slot on the same calendar invite (separate Google Meet links) or send two invites.

Tell me which option you prefer and I’ll coordinate calendars. Karthik/ Lauren — looping you in to confirm we can staff both blocks and who will lead each section.

Best,
